P01.rationale: The founder (Jousef) is the dominant human anchor with a large, prominent portrait occupying the upper half of the page.

P05.rationale: While there are no specific case study portraits shown in this cover layout, the 'In diesem Report' section clearly frames and names the client (APEX Consulting) at a meaningful size.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus like a press wall or review grid; only generic statistics are presented in a box.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative typographic elements are present in the headline 'Dein Wachstum FRISST DICH SELBST AUF' which uses large, stylized lettering.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations are bound to numbers with specific metrics like '100+ AI-Projekte' and '30-50% Kostensenkung' clearly displayed.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks, stats, and imagery without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present through the dark blue gradient overlay on the photo and the textured paper effect in the lower section.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photo is treated with a darkening scrim so that overlaid text remains readable, though some contrast issues exist at the very top edge.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown; the focus is entirely on the person and abstract data visualization.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks specific to a real business context (consulting setting) rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content across all sections.

N10.rationale: Text sits on a busy photo but uses a dark overlay effectively to ensure readability, avoiding awkward inset gaps.
